bio: Project manager for SHARK-NIR; also contributes to adaptive-optics instrument programmes such as MAVIS and MORFEO.
long_bio: Maria is involved in developing and delivering high-contrast astronomical instrumentation. Her work includes project management for SHARK-NIR at the Large Binocular Telescope, alongside collaborations on advanced adaptive-optics instruments such as MAVIS and MORFEO. These programmes bring precision optics, instrument verification and coordinated engineering to the search for faint objects near bright stars.
